sentences: For liable departures from 1 January 2027, this bill would raise the passenger movement charge to $80 instead of $70.
Passengers whose tickets were sold on or before Royal Assent would retain the $70 rate for departures through 30 June 2028.
From 1 July 2028, liable departures would attract the $80 rate regardless of when the ticket was bought.
changes: Raises the charge on eligible departures from Australia by $10.
Ties the new rate to departure dates from January 2027, with an eighteen-month transition for qualifying earlier bookings.
Keeps the existing rate during that transition for tickets or equivalent travel authorities issued before commencement.
Ends the earlier-booking exception for departures from July 2028.
summary.affected: Travellers liable for the charge, airlines, shipping and charter operators, and border officials collecting it are affected.
